dialogue.captain_quest_1.root.line_0.tex: [STUB] Every port I dock at, I mean to send a card home. Never do.
dialogue.captain_quest_1.root.line_1.tex: [STUB] Bring me ten of them and I'll put a word in for you at the market.
dialogue.dlg_intro_tilde.cool.line_0.tex: I understand, I'll drop by later.
dialogue.dlg_intro_tilde.root.line_0.tex: I heard you've opened a shop…
dialogue.dlg_quest_01.root.line_0.text: I need one book. Can you help?
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_0.text: So this is that new shop everyone's talking about. And here I thought the rumors were exaggerating.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_1.text: Rumors rarely exaggerate for the better. Come in — it's quiet right now.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_2.text: Quiet is good. I can't stand picking books in a crowd.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_3.text: Then you're in luck. What are you after — something specific, or just browsing?
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_4.text: Just browsing, mostly. A good book usually finds me on its own.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_5.text: There are plenty of them here, so its chances are pretty good.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_6.text: I like that confidence in a shopkeeper. Usually it's in short supply.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_7.text: I just know my shelves. If you need anything, don't hesitate to ask.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_8.text: Deal. And… I'm glad you've finally opened.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_9.text: Thank you. Make yourself at home — this is a place you can linger in.
dialogue.eddy_quest_1.root.line_0.text: [STUB] I had one more thought about this shop.
dialogue.eddy_quest_1.root.line_1.text: [STUB] Keep an eye on what people ask for. Patterns matter.
dialogue.eddy1.agree.line_0.speaker: Morgan
dialogue.eddy1.agree.line_0.text: That's why I came here - I'm looking for my calling.
dialogue.eddy1.disagree.line_0.speaker: Morgan
dialogue.eddy1.disagree.line_0.text: I know exactly what I want.
dialogue.eddy1.dream.line_0.speaker: Morgan
dialogue.eddy1.dream.line_0.text: I always dreamed of having a bookshop.
dialogue.eddy1.dream.line_1.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.dream.line_1.text: It's a good thing, finding your calling in life.
dialogue.eddy1.job.line_0.speaker: Morgan
dialogue.eddy1.job.line_1.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.job.line_1.text: That's true. But you know what they say? If you find your calling, you'll never work a day in your life!
dialogue.eddy1.mid.line_0.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.mid.line_0.text: Though you look far too young for that. Everything can still change many times over.
dialogue.eddy1.outro.line_0.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.outro.line_0.text: Well, looks like it's time for you to open the little shop. Customers have already noticed you and are heading this way.
dialogue.eddy1.outro.line_1.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.outro.line_1.text: I'll pick out something to read this evening myself, so retirement doesn't get too dull.
dialogue.eddy1.root.line_0.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.root.line_0.text: There we go, the last signature is in place. This place is yours now.
dialogue.eddy1.root.line_1.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.root.line_1.text: And a well-earned retirement is waiting for me. For 40 years, I made children happy with sweets right here in this very spot.
dialogue.millie1.root.line_0.speaker: Millie
dialogue.millie1.root.line_0.text: [STUB] Hi. I left a letter for you.
dialogue.millie1.root.line_1.speaker: Millie
dialogue.millie1.root.line_1.text: [STUB] If someone asks for facts, find them something exact.
dialogue.tara_quest_1.root.line_0.text: [STUB] The children keep asking me for stories and I never know what to pick.
dialogue.tara_quest_1.root.line_1.text: [STUB] Find the right one for five of them and I'll get you a berth at the port.
[STUB] Back already? Good - before you run off, let me show you something.
[STUB] Every shopkeeper keeps a journal: your tasks, the people you meet, what to do next.
[STUB] Give it a tap when you're ready - it's right there on your screen.
